product_title: Handcrafted Pink Floral Decorative Diya Holder Pair with Pearl Border
product_description: Enhance your festive decorations with this beautiful handcrafted Pink Floral Decorative Diya Holder Pair. Featuring a rich magenta twisted-thread base, elegant peach and pink artificial flowers, delicate green foliage, and an exquisite pearl border, these diya holders bring a luxurious and traditional touch to your home decor. Each holder features a golden diya placement area, beautifully complemented by vibrant floral arrangements and intricate detailing. Perfect for decorating pooja rooms, home temples, festive tables, and entranceways, this decorative pair is ideal for Diwali, Lakshmi Puja, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other special occasions. Combining vibrant colors with elegant floral artistry, these decorative diya holders create a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.
product_care_suggestion: Gently remove dust using a soft, dry cloth or a soft-bristled brush.
Avoid washing or immersing the product in water to protect the threadwork, artificial flowers, and pearl embellishments.
Keep away from moisture and humidity to maintain the product's appearance.
Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to preserve the vibrant colors of the flowers and threadwork.
Do not use harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Handle the artificial flowers and pearl borders gently to prevent damage or detachment.
Store in a cool, dry place inside a protective box when not in use.
For safe diya use, ensure the flame remains well away from artificial flowers, threads, and other decorative materials. Never leave a lit diya unattended.
